documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V1.0: PPA-CF
Bambu PPA-CF Safety Data Sheet SDS20260701N06
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility
PET-CF / PPA-CF / PPS-CF / PA6 CF Carbon Fibers Filament Usage Guide

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values (Mechanical Properties; specimens printed on an X1C at chamber 52 °C, nozzle 290 °C, bed 110 °C, 80 mm/s, 100% infill, not annealed before testing); the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 57 ± 5 MPa, elongation 0.9 ± 0.2 %, bending modulus 3240 ± 360 MPa, bending strength 63 ± 4 MPa, impact 4.3 ± 0.4 kJ/m²) are not stored. Density, melting, glass transition, Vicat and HDT come from the TDS Physical Properties table and sit under material.* / thermal.*, apart from the printed-specimen mechanical.* rows.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 11800 ± 670 MPa, Z 4300 ± 340 MPa), melt index (8.4 ± 0.7 g/10 min at 280 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature (178 °C, DSC 10 °C/min), heat deflection temperature 227 °C at 0.45 MPa, saturated water absorption rate (1.30% at 25 °C, 55% RH), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH, sealed, with desiccant), retraction length (0.8 - 1.4 mm) and speed (20 - 40 mm/s), chamber temperature (50 - 80 °C), max overhang angle (~ 70 °), max bridging length (~ 40 mm), spool size (diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm), spool temperature resistance (145 °C), suggested annealing of prints (120 to 140 °C, 6 to 12 hours), the note that a higher chamber temperature (70 - 80 °C) would give higher mechanical properties, odor, skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products rows.

The TDS recommended chamber temperature (50 - 80 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability (number, template field chamber_temp_max), not a filament print setting.
